summary.name: Top 50 Text-to-Image Prompts (Metaverse Post)
summary.one_liner: A Metaverse Post article listing 50 example text-to-image prompts, with Midjourney-style parameters, for AI art generators such as Midjourney and DALL-E.
keywords: list of art words for ai
use_cases: Learning Midjourney prompt syntax and parameters
Finding style and art-movement keywords for prompts
summary.what_it_does: The page is a curated list of 50 example prompts for text-to-image AI art tools, mostly written in Midjourney style with flags such as --ar for aspect ratio, --s or --stylize, --no for negative terms, and --wallpaper. Each prompt is a short descriptive phrase, often adding render or artist-style terms like octane render or Beksinski. It also includes a list of about 250 art-related words and a list of 50 general words that the author says help produce interesting outputs. The intro says Midjourney and DALL-E generate images from natural language, and mentions a 12-billion-parameter GPT-3 model trained on text-image pairs. The page does not describe any software features, pricing, or platforms beyond these prompts.
notable: Includes a list of about 250 art and style words for prompting
Points to a separate article on Stable Diffusion prompts and one on text-to-video prompts
caveats: Prompts use Midjourney-specific flags, so they may not work the same way in DALL-E or other generators
Page is a list of examples rather than a tool, and it does not state which generator version the prompts were tested on
